laws.rule: Krkonoše National Park: from 1 November to 30 April access to some roads is prohibited to protect wintering animals (measure OOP 1/2023). Cycling off roads only on marked, reserved cycle routes. In quiet zones move only on designated routes.
laws.heading: Krkonoše National Park
